author: OpenAI
description:
OpenAI and LG Uplus engineers collaborated to create a next-generation AICC, “Agentic AICC,” which is positioned to become a new standard for enterprise AI customer service.

LG Uplus plans to introduce an agent service featuring ultra-low-latency AI customer support built on the OpenAI Realtime API, along with a Planning Agent that can resolve issues on its own using checklist-based workflows.
